bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to workforce development; appropriating money for displaced homemaker programs.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; MINNESOTA FAMILY RESILIENCY PARTNERSHIP.

$350,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $350,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the workforce development fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for the Minnesota Family Resiliency Partnership under Minnesota Statutes, section 116L.96. The commissioner, through the adult career pathways program, shall distribute the funds to existing nonprofit and state displaced homemaker programs. These are onetime appropriations.
additions: $350,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $350,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the workforce development fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for the Minnesota Family Resiliency Partnership under Minnesota Statutes, section 116L.96.
